svg.text: Layered Defense System Against Knowledge Poisoning and Prompt Injection in Network Intrusion Detection
Clean Accuracy: Proportional baseline 74%, Resilient 68%, Balanced baseline 73%, Resilient 67%
False Refusal: Proportional resilient 1%, Balanced resilient 4%
Attack ASR: 0% all conditions (baseline no success detected, resilient refused all attacks)
Bruteforce: 16–20% accuracy (retrieval blind spot, not code defect)
Benign: 88% → 100% with balanced KB (retrieval prior effect)
